title: Optimize / Evals review scratchpad — prep for 1:1 and sync
content:
Purpose / audience:
- Personal prep notes for 1:1 with Jordan and weekly Optimize/Evals sync (Mar 15). Holder for talking points, quick numbers, and concrete follow-ups I want to surface.

Top-line summary (what I’ll say in 1 sentence):
- We’ve observed three small but actionable quality regressions after the most recent quant+kernel rollout; A/B shows higher hallucination rate on search-heavy prompts and mismatch on temperature-sensitive prompt sets. Goal: prioritize prompt-level rollback/mitigation for high-impact routes and create targeted evals to validate patches.

Quick metrics snapshot (from console + local evals):
- Global pass rate on core eval suite: 94.1% -> 91.4% (delta -2.7pp) since rollout on 2026-03-02.
- Hallucination indicator (heuristic): 1.5% -> 3.9% (delta +2.4pp) on web-search prompts (route: hosted-api/search). Sample size: 2.4k requests.
- Response divergence (edit distance proxy) on prompt-set A (docs summarization): median token edit distance up 12% vs baseline.
- In AB test (var-A new kernel + int8 vs var-B baseline fp16): var-A generated 6.3% lower factuality score in crowdsourced judgments (n=600), p~0.03.

Immediate hypotheses (quick, ranked):
1) Quantization path/rounding edgecases for rare token embeddings -> degraded ability to surface exact entities (e.g., product IDs)
2) Kernel scheduling change increased micro-batching for long-context requests, changing kv-cache timing and small timing-dependent decoding differences
3) Prompt normalization pipeline mismatch (we added a fast trim on whitespace for cost reasons last rollout) causing tokenization boundary shifts for a subset of prompts

Sample failing prompts (to show Jordan):
- "Find the latest compliance policy for export control — list the section numbers and short quotes." (expected many exact matches, model returns approximate paraphrases)
- "Given this support conversation, generate a DB-safe summary with the user PII redacted." (baseline redacted user ID exactly; new variant left a partial ID)
- Prompt-set A example: long doc + "Summarize into 5 bullets, include any dates and named orgs." -> produced bullets that ommitted a key date in 21/120 cases.

Evidence links I’ll pull in the meeting (fast-access):
- Console: per-route quality dashboard (hosted-api/search) -> filter dates 2026-03-01..2026-03-12
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prs/4321 (quant kernel + fast-trim change)
- JIRA: OPT-987 (regression triage board) and OPT-992 (A/B analysis notes)
- Slack thread: #optimize-evals · thread ts=1670000000 referenced above (I'll paste a snippet)

What I want from Jordan / sync attendees:
- Quick sanity-check on rollout timing and whether any infra incidents correlate with the worst drop windows. (Owner: Jordan)
- Decision on immediate mitigation: prefer soft rollback on quant path (if cheap) OR patch prompt-normalization (if smaller blast radius). Need ops cost estimate. (Owner: Product + Eng: Jordan + Ravi)
- Approval to run expanded A/B with stratified traffic for hosted-api/search for an extra 48h to collect +1.5k samples. (Owner: Me to execute with Data: Sana)

Concrete experiment plan (short):
- Short-term (24–72h):
  - Launch targeted A/B where 20% of search traffic -> baseline kernel (fp16) and 80% stays on new. Collect per-request hallucination signal + latency + token-cost. (Owner: Sana, Data)
  - Add logging whitelist for exact-match entity tokens to capture tokenization boundary cases. (Owner: Eng infra: Ravi)
  - Backfill human sample judgments for the 600 ambiguous cases flagged by heuristics (crowd + internal). (Owner: Me + CS: Loren)
- Medium-term (1–2 weeks):
  - If A/B confirms degradation, implement quant rounding bias fix in PR-4321 branch (Eng: Mark).
  - Add prompt-normalization unit tests (inc boundary/whitespace) and integrate into pre-deploy evals. (Owner: DevEx: Priya)

Open questions / TODOs to decide in 1:1:
- Is there appetite for immediate rollback of the quant kernel on dedicated pools only (minimize customer blast)? Pros/cons: targeted rollback lowers customer impact but delays broader perf gains.
- Do we have a short-term budget for expanded human evals? (cost ~ $1.2k for additional 1k judgements)
- Are any enterprise customers hitting this route with SLAs we need to notify? Quick check with CS.

Draft talking points (verbatim I might read):
- "We saw a modest but measurable drop in quality aligned with the 3/2 kernel + quant rollout. Impact is concentrated on search-style prompts that need exact matches. I recommend a time-boxed A/B and a prioritized short fix while we fully root-cause. My ask: decision on risk appetite for a partial rollback and approval to run the expanded evals."

Follow-ups I’ll add to checklist after meeting (and assign):
- [ ] Confirm if any SRE incidents around 2026-03-03..2026-03-05 (Jordan)
- [ ] Kickoff A/B split + metrics dashboard (Sana)
- [ ] Add token-boundary logging and share logs (Ravi)
- [ ] Draft customer-facing note if rollback is likely (CS + Legal)
- [ ] Add new unit tests to prompt-normalizer (Priya)
- [ ] Schedule 30m follow-up sync on Mar 18 to review AB results (Me)

Handy notes for ad-hoc questions:
- If asked about latency impact: kernel+quant saved ~12–18% cost and reduced p95 latency by ~60ms on median long-context jobs (data in PR).
- If asked about scope: worst regressions seen on routes with long-document + entity extraction; short chat prompts unaffected in current sample.

Personal moderation / reminders (notes to self):
- Don’t over-commit to a full rollback — push for short A/B and narrow mitigations first.
- Bring concrete numbers, not vague "it got worse" statements; have sample ids and 3 anonymized examples ready.
- Keep the tone constructive: framing as tradeoff between perf/cost and exact-match correctness.

Appendix (small snippets to paste into meeting chat):
- "Observed hallucination heuristic spike: hosted-api/search 2026-03-02 -> 2026-03-09: 1.5% -> 3.9% (n=2400). A/B human judgments (n=600) show factuality drop 6.3% on var-A (new quant path). See PR 4321 and JIRA OPT-987 for details."
- Example anonymized user prompt + baseline vs variant outputs (3 pairs) — will paste during sync.

End of scratchpad.

-- Avery

(Quick note: move finalized follow-ups into Confluence page CONFLUENCE-OPT-523 after meeting.)
